title: Count the words
prompt: Write word_count(sentence) that returns how many words the sentence has. Words are separated by one or more spaces; there may be extra spaces at the start and end.
hints: How would you count words in a sentence on paper? Where does each new word begin?
Counting the spaces gives the wrong answer when there are extra spaces. Python has a string method that splits text into words and ignores extra whitespace.
Plan: split the sentence into a list of words with .split() (with no argument), then count the list with len().

edge_hints.spaces: Extra spaces at the start, end or between words must not create extra words. Look at what .split() does with no argument.
